notes.title: 1.122 Release
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] New Multi Autobattle Popup! Play all available matches with a single button press (VIP Pass Lvl. 5 required)
[*] Re-worked Archive’s Clash tab into Events tab, which supports both Clash, Melee and Global BGEs
[*] Many bug fixes and optimizations!
[/list]

notes.title: ⚙️Update Version 1.97.0
notes.notes:
Version 1.97.0 of Animation Throwdown has just been released on all platforms!
 
[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now save decks that have less than 25 cards!
[*] You can now more easily switch your active deck before entering any of the battles in the game!
[/list]

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Epic stones should now have an info popup showing the card pool they pull from.
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Refilling adventure energy before doing an auto-battle should no longer force you into regular combat.
[*] Performing multiple card upgrades on a slow network connection should no longer cause cards to display incorrectly in your deck.
[*] Skill icons should no longer display incorrectly when scrolling through the list of combos for a card.
[*] The Giggitywatts counter in the inventory screen should now update correctly after spending Giggitywatts to upgrade a card.
[*] Fixed a visual issue with previewing an unresearched combo while in combat.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing you from viewing the Siege rules more than once per session.
[*] The drop rates text for Mom's Mystery Box now scrolls instead of expanding off the screen.
[/list]

notes.title: ⚙️Version 1.96.0
notes.notes:
[b]Improvements:[/b]
• You can now filter Power Cards separately from character and object cards in the deck screen.

[b]Fixes:[/b]
• Brawl popup now correctly displays the number of points awarded from winning.
• Logging into a Kongregate account will now correctly complete the "Kongregate to Victory" quest.
• The Combo Mastery tube should no longer get stuck when logging into a new device while CM research is in progress.
• Additional improvements for stability and connectivity

notes.title: 📢 Arena Update coming Wednesday, May 2!

Win and loss points for Arena battles are getting an update! The update should give a small, but helpful boost to speed up players’ Arena progress.

notes.title: Throwdown Version 1.95.0
notes.notes:
[b]New Features and Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now see the specific combo cards affected by Combo BGEs!
[*] You can now filter by character/object cards in the deck and research screens!
[*] Cards now display whether they are character or object cards in the info popup!
[*] The events and challenges popup has been reorganized to be easier to navigate.
[*] Mail messages will now include links to forum posts with more information when relevant.
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the combo mastery screen would appear to be locked after installing on a new device while a mastery research was already in progress.
[*] Fixed an issue where the research tutorial would sometimes break and show a combo that has already been researched.
[*] Fixed an issue on web where the game would get stuck loading at 13%.
[/list]

notes.title: Throwdown Update - Version 1.94.0
notes.notes:

[*] The card carousels in the deck screen no longer scroll back to the beginning after upgrading a card.

notes.title: SFC Updates, Hero Token Changes, and more
notes.notes:
[h1]Secret Fight Club (SFC) Updates[/h1]

[list]
[*] Score cap will be expanded from 2500 to 3500
[*] Starting at 2500, the SFC Battleground Effect (BGE) will give the enemy deck a bonus percentage based on the player’s score (not the opponent’s score).
[*] A trophy as well as the rank and score of top SFC players will be displayed in Arena, Guild Rumbles, and other areas of the game.
[/list]

This change is expected to go live on November 28, 2018. We will continue to monitor Arena and player feedback for further improvements if needed.

[h1]Hero Token Changes[/h1]

We have updated the way Hero Tokens refresh in Arena. You are now able to “lock in” the Hero Token so that it will not change after a battle is completed. This means that once you find the hero you want tokens for, you can keep grinding for those specific tokens only. You will still get a new opponent after each battle.

The selection is automatic: simply do not refresh your opponent to keep the Hero Token drop the same. The selection should be saved even if you close the game and continue playing later. Of course, you have the option to refresh your opponent and token, if desired. Opponent and Hero Tokens are still linked: if you refresh one it will refresh the other.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

We have been investigating a recent 51 guild member issue and have implemented a fix. This should hopefully prevent further issues in upcoming events; but we will continue to monitor, investigate, and fix as needed.

We are also aware that our recent update has caused some ranking boards to display incorrectly. It should now be fixed, but you may need to restart your game to see the changes.
